pictures.author: Alexander Migl (Alexander-93)
pictures.observed: Actually viewed960px portrait crop: gray-beige horizontal brickwork, stepped wall/low glazed base, white-framed glass stack, metal copings and small roof grilles. Signs/posters omitted.

pictures.author: Sebastian Koppehel
pictures.observed: Actually viewed1280px broad Museumplein elevation: rounded pale panel-clad Kurokawa exhibition volume, continuous sloping overhanging silver roof and upper glazing slot; curved glazed entrance at right; behind it the brick Rietveld block/dark tall white-grid stack and low glazed perimeter. pictures.author: Steven Lek (Tukka)
pictures.observed: Actually viewed1280px street elevation: large largely blind gray-beige brick upper wall, tall frosted glazed stack with regular pale frame grid, ground-floor glazed ribbon and flat metal entrance canopy. Trees/fence/signboards not reconstructed.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Full mapped Van Gogh Museum exterior: stepped Rietveld gray-beige brick volumes and low glazed perimeter, two tall white-framed dark/frosted glazed stacks, light roof strips/clerestories, Kurokawa stone semicircular exhibition volume with sloping overhanging metal roof/clerestory, and northern curved glazed entrance with a real recessed doorway. One parent multipolygon owns both principal volumes; retain the intervening original ground and every independent Stedelijk/Moco building. Exterior only: no art posters, signs, furnished galleries, underground theater or unseen connecting passages.
